title: Recidivism
pdf_title: CHAPTER 9 RECIDIVISM The information on 'Recidivism' was available in respect of 19,94,921 offenders during the year 1981 out of which 18,64,103 i.e., 93.5 per cent were new offenders. The percentage of persons who were convicted once, twice and thrice or more was 4.6 percent, 1.3 percent and 0.6 percent respectively. It was found that 17.6 percent of the persons arrested for the offence of 'Dacoity' were convicted in the past and this accounted for the highest percentage of 'Recidivism' closely followed by 'Thefts' (15.7 percent), 'Burglary' (15.3 percent) and 'Robbery' (12.6 percent). The relevant statistics in respect of number of offenders and their percentage distribution of 'Recidivism' are presented in Table—53 and 54.
